suite.doc:
Salary Account E2E: ONE test that walks the whole business flow.
Payslip (created by the fixture) -> Salary Account form -> month picker -> payslip dropdown -> auto patched fields + preview -> non editable -> save -> duplicate payslip is no longer listed.
Run this first. If it passes, the fixture, the page keywords and the components all work together, and the full test case file is safe to run.
